about: The Workbench icons of the BlockAttack drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's source/misc/icons/blockattack48.png. BlockAttack-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, BlockAttack.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's BlockAttack.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licences; Folder.info for data, user and the drawers in them.
